nom: cocokind Milky-Soft Face and Body Wash

avis.texte: I liked the gel and lather but after 2-3 washes I noticed my skin was getting worse with tiny bumps and redness around my eyes. This was the only new product introduced to my skincare. I swiched back to the Vanicream gel cleanser and my weird rash went away. My skin is not usually sensitive with products

Now this is a product i wanted to love, i bought it to replace my current face wash & after the first use my skin was burning and bright red, I originally thought it was because if the towel i used on my face after the morning face wash but the next night i used it and stright after again my face was burning and bright red. I dont normally have sensitive skin and it can handle a lot.

I used this on my face twice already and have gotten the same stripping feel and irritation around my T zone area. personally my skin is more sensitive around the T zone so that may be why my skins turned so red after using. Works great on the body with no complaints though ! Try at your own discretion

Love this cleanser! It's lightweight but still lathers and makes my skin feel soft and clean. This is also perfect for travel since it doubles as a face and body cleanser, cuts down on one more travel size bottle I need to pack. I keep a stock of this on hand so I don't run out!

avis.titre: Very gentle and awesome second cleanse!
avis.texte: I've been using this product for about three months now, and it's incredibly gentle! I usually prefer fragranced body washes, so I mainly use this cleanser on my face. It's my go-to on days when I'm mostly staying at home. On its own, I don't find that it completely removes tinted or silicone-based sunscreens (I have oily skin). However, when I use it as my second cleanse after the oil-to-milk cleanser, it removes all of my sunscreen and makeup without leaving my skin feeling stripped. It's a great gentle cleanser that works especially well as part of a double-cleansing routine.
My husband likes to say he was tricked into washing his face with a 2-1 now haha! We love it! It leaves our faces feeling soft. Great for a gentle cleanser!

Wanted to love! Unfortunately, as has happened to some others, this wash burns my eyes and just doesnt work on my face. It also burns my lady bits if the lather gets too close! Only cocokind product Ive ever had a negative reaction to. I do like to use this cleanser as a shaving cream in the shower, however I wont be repurchasing.
This is my third repurchase and I'll likely see if I can set this up for subscription but this is a great shower product for your entire body. Highly recommend for all skin types.
Must have step in my double cleanse , it cleans everything without leaving my skin dry and tight

I really like the feel of the milky-soft face and body cleanser. It leaves my skin feeling soft, clean, and moisturized. The bottle at first seemed smaller than Id like for the price but after using it I realized a little goes a long way. Great product!

avis.titre: This product has been a dream come true!
avis.texte: This has been a dream come true! I love that it is for face and body. No fragrance and gentle. I absolutely love it!
My first subscription product and it was a no-brainer. Its perfect. It lathers and cleans beautifully, without drying me out. A little goes a long way, and I love the pump! No notes.

avis.titre: The best face and body wash
avis.texte: This is the absolute best face and body wash. The texture is so creamy and it leaves your skin so soft. A must have for everyone!
I use this all over. Dont leave your skin dry. It gives your skin a moist look.

avis.titre: Cocokind Milky-Soft Face and Body Wash
avis.texte: I wanted to love this, but it broke me out so bad. Pimples all over my back, shoulders, and neck. My face got a lot more texture as well, kp and closed Comodones :( Really frustrating, wouldn't recommend if you are acne prone.
Looooove!! I've always had acne on my chest and back and I finally found a cleanser that actually cleans these areas and has cleared them up so much. Huge confidence booster

Love this non-drying cleanser. As a sensitive and acne-prone girly, I just need a cleanser that'll clean the skin and do nothing else. Surprisingly, that's hard to find! This one leaves skin feeling soft but clean.

This is genuinely such an amazing product! It leaves my skin feeling smooth and hydrated and clean without feeling stripped. Id recommend this to literally anyone! I also love that its low toxic and cruelty free!
Super gentle and non-stripping but strong enough to make my oily acne prone skin feel and look clean! highly recommend, especially for sensitive skin
Love, love love. If you have eczema this will be great product to try. This is my second bottle.
Leaves skin supported and not stripped. Lathers well, cleanses well, moisturizes well. I will never use anything else ever again please do not change this product.
SO good for the shower!! Love to use on my face and body! Leaves my skin feeling clean and soft without also feeling stripped! Lathers great with a loofa for body use!

avis.titre: always have to have a back up on my shelf never run out
avis.texte: 57 oily tzone normal elsewhere . love this wash. Leaves my skin clean but does not leave it stripped and tight feeling. My skin loves it

avis.titre: Facial Skin Reaction, not for everyone.
avis.texte: I really love the idea of this product, but it's not as universal of a product like oil to milk cleanser. My face skin does not like something in the product and has a red, swollen reaction. It 100% feels like a soft, gentle lather going on, leaving your skin feeling clean and smooth. But I'm personally having a reaction afterwards, leaving rashy redness that burns my face skin shortly after use and I'm experiencing red, swollen face for about 30 minutes. I can't use any other facial products with this product without it worsening my reaction.

I wanted so badly to love this product - I've tried numerous products (and loved) everything and never had any issues with irritation, etc. Unfortunately, this product turned my face bright red, and it felt like it was burning. I tried it out a couple of times and purposely did not use any other products at the same time to ensure it was really from this item. I had the same reaction each time, and the redness/irritation would last for a day or two. The oat milk cleanser has been my go-to for years, so I've gone back to that and have no issues.

I'm a cocokind regular, and was excited to try this cleanser. It is exactly what my dry and sensitive skin has needed, so much so that some lines on my forehead have minimized. It's the only change I made in my routine, and my skin is so soft (and not dry) that the lines are disappearing. I wasn't expecting this, and it is why I came to write a review. I only gave it 4 stars because the coconut ingredient smell (not coconut scent) is a bit overpowering for me. I'll continue to use it and just not breathe it in, but wanted to mention it for others who are sensitive to smells.

avis.titre: Get it, you won't regret it.
avis.texte: This is truly one of the best face washes I have ever used. It lathers very well and it feel so soft on my skin. Once I wash it off my face feels clean, soft, and not stripped.

Was looking for a switch up from my typical face wash and LOVE this face wash! Its creamy and soothing on your face and foams up great and youre left feeling clean but not that icky tight feeling. It removes sunscreen and light makeup and doesnt irritate my sensitive and reactive skin. For the price, the bottle is huge and I know this will last me awhile.

I want to love this product sooooooo badly because it is a GREAT price and is so gentle on the skin. I love EVERYTHING by cocokind but this broke me out so badly. PLEASE PLEASE PLEASE reformulate with no pore clogging ingredients and remove laminaria digitata extract. Please!!!!
I was holding some doubts on a cleanser for face & body, but this is fantastic! It doesnt strip or dry skin at all. In fact it leaves it feeling clean, hydrated and happy.

Obsessed with this cleanser. Ive struggled to find products gentle enough that arent stripping or drying. As someone who used to be on Isotretinoin, I highly recommend this! Its become essential in my morning and nightly skincare routines!

This cleanser strikes the perfect balance between efficacious cleansing and not stripping my dry, sensitive skin. I actually like it better than the viral bioderma oil body cleanser. It feels more luxurious than it costs too.
Love this cleanser and that I dont need to be so â‚¬Å"preciousâ‚¬Â with how much Im using because of the big size. Im planning on taking this on a weekend trip to use for face and body!
I love this cleanser so much!! It has helped me with my blackheads and skin in general, making it always look moisturized and glowy. Im definitely getting more Cocokind after this one!!

I got this with the intention of using it as a body wash but I absolutely love it as a facial cleanser. The texture is so silky. My face is really picky when it comes on to cleanser, while my skin is oily, it is easy for my skin to get dried out and irritated. Essentially, this leaves my skin clean, and silky soft. Give it a try.

avis.titre: Such an amazing and gentle brand..
avis.texte: been using this for a few days and so far so amazing, I have dry, sensitive, and acne prone skin. I needed a new face wash immediately after the last one broke me out so thats when i stumbled across this brand and decided to give it a shot. My face felt so smooth and moisturized after the first wash, i love the gentle ingredients as well. Ive bought a couple more products from cocokind and im completely in love

This needs a matching moisturizer! Simple, lightweight but nourishing. I have the most reactive skin and decided to try this on a whim. Im shocked at how gentle it is for the face, effective enough to remove makeup, and cleansing enough for the body.

I have used cerave cream to foam cleanser for YEARS and this has replaced my holy grail face wash. It cleanses my skin, but doesnt strip it, and lathers beautifully. I have super sensitive skin and this has been a great fit and has helped heal my skin barrier too. Best new Cocokind launch. Just reordered 2 more bottles with the sale.

I'm a skincare junkie. I literally have baskets of skincare products, tons even unopened. I rarely reorder something. It has to really work or really wow me. This product has! I reordered two already! It cleans so effortlessly and leaves my face so silky soft! Definitely my new FAVORITE cleanser, and the fact that it's huge is a major bonus! I have yet to try it as a body cleanser, but I can only imagine it'd be just as silky! Kudos. This is a great addition to the Cocokind brand ˜Š

I adore this cleanser! Its so gentle and non-stripping but gives a nice, thorough cleanse. I love it for both the face and body. I keep it in the shower so I can use for both! You cannot beat the quality or the price!
This cleanser is so gentle yet hydrating!! I love using it for my morning routine to feel fresh!
This cleanser is a must for your shower routine! My skin is super sensitive so this is perfect since it is super lightweight and smooth.

This cleanser does exactly as described. It cleanses gently without stripping and leaves your skin feeling soft and clean. It does not have fragrance, which is ideal for sensitive skin or any skin type really. The texture is luxurious and turns into a gentle foam with water. One of my favorite cleansers!

The packaging of this cleanser is very cute, and the pump is well made. It doesnt splatter everywhere with just one press. The formula is gentle yet cleans effectively. Maybe Im getting olderI used to love Japanese soap-based cleansers, but now I cant handle that overly strong, squeaky-clean feeling anymore.
Broke me out in hives! not safe for sensitive skin strong fragrance and is extremely stripping.

I have been searching high & low for a body wash. I have eczema and sensitive skin. Find a body wash that wont leave your skin irritated and has a nice subtle scent is hard to come by. My kind of loves it! The smell is amazing! No irritation at all. I used it first as a body wash because I plenty of the oat milk cleanser. I ran out of my oat milk & man using the milky soft in my face was a game changer!

I love using cocokind milky cleanser to wash my face. It lathers softly on your skin, and leaves it feeling hydrated and not stripped. Also I love how it works through makeup made it easy taking it off or the day.

The ONLY face wash that does not burn my tween daughters insanely sensitive skin!!!! Nuf said right there, but it truly is the creamiest, most comfortable and non-stripping cleanser my daughter and I have ever used!

avis.titre: Gentle cleanse amazing for sensitive skin
avis.texte: I bought this face wash hoping for something gentle but effective and it was just that. I tend to have sensitive skin and this face wash hasnt irritated my skin once. It lathers up nicely and removes my makeup and sunscreen from the day with no issues. Best of all my skin never feels stripped or tight afterwards

This cleanser is incredible! Ive been an oil to milk girly for years, like since it came out, so when I saw this coming out, I was so excited! Its so silky and luxurious. I love that its gentle on my face, especially eye area, and leaves my body feeling so soft and clean. Maybe the best part is, it is a 2 in 1 product and perfect for my fiance He was really excited to try another cocokind item, and we both love it! I was hoping it would replace his current products and I was successful!! Get it!

avis.titre: My combo skin loves this cleanser!
avis.texte: this cleanser has become one of my favorites to cleanse my skin! I purchased it as soon as it was released and immediately fell in love with how lightweight and gentle it is on my skin. It does a great job removing makeup and sunscreen, especially when I pair it with the oil to milk cleanser. It's so gentle, my combination skin loves it!
Love this. Im glad I can use one product for my entire body. Its creamy enough to lather really nice so you dont have to use a whole lot of product to get clean! Makes my skin feel great!

I will never shut up about this cleanser. Coming from a girl whos been using the same cleanser for years and finally decide to try something new and Im never going back! This feels so silky, so luxe, and its the perfect amount of iI feel like this cleaned my faceu without being stripping. Love love loveeeee how this feels on my face!
Love the versatility of this cleanser! Its also a huge win when I find a cleanser that doesnt burn my eyes.

avis.titre: One and done...if you need convenience
avis.texte: This is delightful. I am even using this as my hand soap at the sink. When I don't want to do a full skin care routine, this is amazing for a quick face wash and moisturize. Honestly I want to plug this as disability friendly because--unless you are wearing a lot of make up or sunscreen--you can just use this in the shower as a one and done. I'm curious to see if I will feel the need to moisturize in the summer with this even. There is a luxurious richness to it. I am not usually a fan of multitasking products but this goes beyond face and body to me too. I want my eczema kiddo to be more diligent with it because it has soothed some of my sensitivities--will report back when I know more.

avis.titre: My new go to in the shower
avis.texte: Love how gentle this product is while still getting a real clean. No fragrance but still smells fresh!
Ive been loving using this as shaving cream lately! My legs feel so smooth and moisturized after! Also love using it as a body wash too.

avis.titre: My dry skin found love with this milky cleanser
avis.texte: The perfect milky cleanser for your face and body. Im a dry skin girl so my skin eats up milky products and this one is a *chefs kiss* perfect match for my skin. Im not usually a fan of combo products but this product has changed my mind.

I LOVE this wash! It feels gentle and nourishing for my acne combo skin! I love the price for the size and dual use, but only wish is that it came in a jumbo size for my shower since both my hubby and I use it for face and body.
This removes all my makeup and leaves my skin feeling soft and hydrated!

This face and body wash is absolutely wonderful! I was skeptical, as almost all products claiming to be two things are mediocre at best. This is the real deal and I am ashamed I ever doubted Cocokind. They rarely miss! The milky lather is hydrated, soft, non-stripping, and leaves the skin so silky smooth. I especially enjoy it for shaving my legs in the shower.

I absolutely LOVE this body wash! I have very sensitive skin, so much so that I was using baby shower gel as my body wash. Thankfully cocokind came out with this cleanser. Its a little stripping for my face so I stick to the oil to milk cleanser, however, as a body wash five stars, please dont stop making this product. Otherwise I gotta go back to the Baby stuff. Thank you. Girl from Florida

avis.titre: Better than ANY other gentle cleanser
avis.texte: Works amazing and my skin feels so smooth and hydrated after! Was using LRP Lipikar Gentle Foaming Cleanser for a while and decided to try this and the difference is night and day! I thought I was already using a gentle cleanser but this is just so much better!

I wanted to love this cleanser but it made my skin burn, itchy and very dry. I have extremely sensitive and dry skin but most cocokind products work really well for my skin so I thought this one would too. I will stick to my tried and true oil to milk cleanser, my skin loves that one and it doesnt make it feel dry at all.
I love this stuff!!! So gentle but so effective. Does not dry me out at all and I love how big the size is. Sticking with this one for a while

This product lathers well and feels great upon application but I noticed my eczema patches feeling tight and stripped once my skin was no longer damp. I tried this with various amounts of product but still had varying degrees of the same result. I will say this feels fabulous on areas of my skin where Im not having an eczema flare up. Because this does not work for my whole body, I dont see myself repurchasing. I really wanted to love it though! Cocokind is usually a skincare slam dunk for me.

Absolutely love this product. Ive been wanting a foamy non-drying face wash for so long, and this one delivered. I also love how much product is in this. As an eczema + dry skin girlie this is great and leaves my skin feeling clean, no irritation, and hydrated!

Personally I didnt find this to be as gentle as described. I was using it on my face in the shower and found that I had to use the teeniest tiniest bit or my face would come out feeling totally dry and stripped. Even with only using a tiny amount, I still find it leaves my skin dry and a little flaky. I love cocokind products in general but will discontinue using this one.

I heard such amazing things about this product and wanted to love it…. Ive been looking for a cleanser that is gentle, but leaves my face feeling clean. Unfortunately, after consistent use for a few weeks, this really stripped my barrier to the point i have to stop. I would not suggest this for someone with dry, sensitive, acne prone skin

This is my absolute favorite face wash. I have dry and acne prone skin, so making sure my face is clean without stripping my barrier is really important and this face cleanser is perfect for that. I can't recommend it enough, especially for the value you get from the size. Cocokind please never discontinue this product!! I'm obsessed
This cleanser is a great addition to lineup. I use it by itself and paired with the oil cleanser when I want to double cleanse. I also love that it comes in a larger size.

I purchased thanks to Tik Tok and I am amazed at how well this works. I have very dry skin yet my skin feels clean and moisturized after using this. My sister on the contrary has oily skin. Although she has oily skin and is acneprone, this is a great cleanser that cleans her skin and isnt overly moisturizing either. One more thing that I absolutely love about this Cocokind product is that they are Leaping Bunny certified. There are many great products on the market but this particular brand is not only amazing but doesnt contribute to animal testing. I will continue to repurchase for this reason.
This body wash and facial cleanser feels like a luxury beauty product without the high price tag! It goes on silky smooth and is perfect for my oily combination skin.
I have sensitive, mature acne prone skin and the cleanser works amazing for me. It feels so silky and leaves my skin feeling clean and hydrated. I already have a backup!

decided to try this on my face to remove my makeup, including waterproof mascara. To my surprise, it works extremely well to remove all my makeup. No tugging or scrubbing hard. I normally use Cocokinds facial cleansing oil to remove my makeup daily but that doesn't come close to removing all makeup w/o rubbing it harder and doing more than a once over. I will buy this from now on to remove my makeup.
The best cleanser Ive ever used. I have combination acne prone skin. This leaves my face clean and hydrated. Non stripping. I even use it with my kids. Cant beat the price for the amount.

Only product that has worked for my extreme body acne! I have hormonal body acne ive used every body cleaner you can think of (im 25 yrs old) ive struggle with body acne since i was 18 and this has been working amazing! My body loves it and its showing. Ive been using this for 1 month now.

This product is so amazing! Feels so luxurious and safe to use on my sensitive skin! It doesnt dry me out like a lot of face washes do! I even love it for my body! The only thing that could possibly make it better is make a refill for it!

This is the first item Ive tried from Cocokind, and it honestly makes me want to explore more of their products. This face and body wash feels truly luxurious and makes my showers feel like a spa experience. The milky texture feels amazing on the skin, and my skin feels so soft and refreshed afterward. I also appreciate that it doesnt break out my face, which is always a concern when using a product for both face and body. I love the convenience of only having to pack one wash for both, especially when traveling. After trying this, Im definitely interested in trying more products from this brand.

My face didnt get red but it did feel a little hot, the texture is nice of this cleanser but Im not sure why it had a burning affect. My fiance tried it and it burned his skin. He said it felt like he got sunburned

Love this. I use this on my body (Ive used it in my face and had no problems, but am using up a nearly full face wash, so sticking to only the body for now). I have fairly reactive, oily, breakout prone skin and in peri. This has been nice and gentle but strong enough to get me clean - I use it after the gym and no problems with it washing the sweat/and smell off. I also use it after I use a sulphur body wash for breakouts on my shoulders, and it totally removes the stink of that. Love that its unscented, so its not competing with my other products.

This cleanser has taken up permanent residence in my shower. Its SO gentle and pleasant to use. I use it after I remove my makeup with the oil to milk cleanser and my sensitive skin has been loving it. Harsh body washes tend to trigger my eczema, but Ive experienced 0 eczema since using this. I also love how much product you get. Will continue to repurchase.

I normally have no issues with cocokind products so I really wanted to like this cleanser. But it did the opposite of what it said it would do for me. I have quite sensitive skin and this made me break out in hives on my face every time I used it and really damaged my skin barrier, overall. Not willing to risk it as a body cleanser so I will he returning.

My skin is so finicky, combination skin, all over. I have used this cleanser for face and body and it leaves my skin so hydrated and soft. I love it even when I don't use moisturizer it still looks and feel soft and smooth. Highly recommend getting this product for the size, price point and quality you cannot go wrong!!

I have been using this as a face wash, its leaving mg face red and irritated. I have developed a slight itchy rash. I am going to try it as a body wash. But i would not recommend some with very sensitive skin to use this. I do love the texture of it and the way it lathers. I really wished it didn't leave my skin red and irritated.
Love thiaface wash. It cleans very well without stripping your face dry. It has a very nice milky texture but lathers very well. Will definitely be repurchasing.

I wanted to love this cleanser so bad for my face as I love everything from CocoKind. However, after every use the cleanser left my skin inflammed with extra redness over my skin. I do enjoy this as a body wash, but I was hoping I found a new staple cleanser 😔

I'm one of those people that tends to buy a different cleanser every time I've finished one, but this is going to be the last cleanser I buy! After a quick oil cleanse, this cleanser washes away any leftover makeup and leaves my face SO clean yet not stripped! This seriously is the best cleanser I have ever tried and I've tried the expensive stuff! I even used it to create a lather before shaving and it was a game changer!!

First, i only used this as a body wash, so right off the bat, id use more than as a face wash. But i went through the bottle super quick. The texture is super watery, a lot would run through my palms, so a lot of waste! Maybe if i put it on a wash cloth or loofah, would it have gone better and lasted longer. Othef than that, i loved using it as a body wash! My skin is super soft after and it didnt aggravate my eczema. Unsure if id buy again just due to the price.

I have only used this cleanser twice so far - so I can't speak on the long term effects of it on my skin - but my first impression of it is that it's a super gentle and effective cleanser that hasn't irritated my skin (on both my face and body) at all. And I also I haven't used it to take off makeup but I think it would do a good job at it. This cleanser leaves my skin feeling really soft and hydrated and not tight and dry like so many other cleansers have in the past. I appreciate that it is fragrance free so much my skin is so sensitive to fragrances. Overall this cleanser is wonderful and such a great value for the price.
THIS IS THAT GIRL! I immediately noticed how soft my skin was after using this cleanser. Its gentle for my sensitive skin, and has a beautiful lather. Now Ive subscribed to get it on a routine basis!
I am absolutely obsessed with this cleanser. My whole house now uses it as a face and body cleanser daily. My son has really sensitive skin and he tolerates it very well.

avis.titre: Great for my sensitive skin & dry winters!
avis.texte: The texture of this cleanser is heavenly! I have used unscented castile soap for years and years, but during this particularly dry Colorado winter my skin has been craving something less stripping. I was so lucky to have won this as a PR mailer and it was just what I needed! Buying a new bottle today after gifting it to my teenagers.

Okay but why is this cleanser low-key the most unproblematic thing in my bathroom? The texture is this soft milky gel that foams just enough to make you feel clean without attacking your skin. No tightness. No squeaky ≈ìdid I just strip my barrier? moment. Just calm, hydrated, happy skin. I use it on my face AND body because we love a multitasking queen. It removes the day without removing my will to live (dramatic, but you get it). Also no strong scent, no weird film, just smooth, comfy skin after every wash. If your skin is sensitive or dry and tired of being betrayed by cleansers¬¶ this is the safe one.

avis.titre: Does the opposite of what it states
avis.texte: I just got it today and I'm taking it back tomorrow because it's that bad

I am obsessed with this new cleanser!!! it feels luxurious every time I use it and i love the way it leaves my skin feeling so soft and clean! I am using it for my body and face, but I especially enjoy it for my face. this is one of my new favorites!!
Felt amazingly luxurious on my skin without drying out my face at all.
Best cleanser I've ever used for my sensitive skin! Left me feeling so soft and truly clean.
Decided to give a try since i have really dry skin. Ive only been using for a few days but I love it!! So much product for a goos price
So soft and creamy, great lather. I love how it removes all of my makeup in one go. So great.

avis.titre: The absolute best cleanser on the market.
avis.texte: Please do yourself a favor and purchase this cleanser. I cannot put into words how truly amazing this product is. It is so gentle, yet effective. It leaves my skin so soft and truly clean, not stripped at all. I already purchased a second bottle to have a backup ready. This product is 100% worth it. I love Cocokindn
It lathers soooo well. A *little* goes a long way plus the bottle is a generous size. Will def be getting this again.

I really like this product as a body wash, it makes my skin smell clean and feels really soft, i love the ingredients especially the ceramide, helps your skin out! As for a face wash, i have dry skin, my skin felt soft but my dry flakes came upon surface fast then usual comparing to other hydrating face washes (like prequel). I love the milky consistency also! I probably wont buy it again, just because i need to finish off other body washes i have stored. But i can feel cocokind doing well with this!
I love how gentle and effective this cleanser is. A little goes a long way so this bottle will last you a while and it's at a great price point.
This cleanser is the best! Its totally worth it for the size of the bottle! The cleanser feels so nice on my skin! I just love it! The texture is incredible and I love love that it is fragrance free!

avis.titre: Definitely will make it into my permanet routine!
avis.texte: It's only been a couple weeks since I've started using this cleanser, but I really love it. It is very gentle on sensitive+acne prone skin, I use it in the morning almost everyday. I think it also makes a great double cleanser, cause its not very stripping at all. It lathers super well on the face (and on the body I imagine). I really do like that it is fragrance-free as well! Definitely will make it into my permanet routine.

This Milky Cleanser from Cocokind has been such a lovely surprise. The texture feels like a treat in the shower and it washes everything away without leaving my skin tight or dry. Perfect for those of us who want clean skin that still feels soft and balanced face and body.

I loved the oil to milk cleanser and now I love this too. Both cleansers together create such a beautiful combo. My skin feels moisturized and cleaned and never stripped. This is amazing for all skin types.

avis.titre: Works surprisingly well on oily skin
avis.texte: I have very oily skin, yet feel like strong/stripping cleansers can make things worse. I've tried my share of creamy, non-foaming, or gentle cleansers but they always leave a film behind which does not work with my oily skin and leaves me prone to more clogged pores. I decided to try this based on a video where the CEO of cocokind explained this left no film behind, yet foamed and removed oil. The feel of this is amazing. My skin can get really irritated and this is simultaneously as gentle as can be while also very cleansing. Removed all oil, left no film behind, and the value is great for the size tube. This will be my go to cleanser morning & night (except a couple times a week I'll use an exfoliating cleanser with acids at night). But this is holy grail status for sure. So are their moisturizers, which are all I'll use. I love their blue moisturizer (water gel one) as well as the texture smoothing cream for ultra dry days when it's 10 degrees out and even my oily skin needs more than the water based one. Everything is soooo gentle and non irritating. Skincare should never be harsh and as a 90s kid I've had to unlearn that (back then us oily gals were given stridex, alcohol based wipes, and cleansers harsher than dish soap lol)
I love this product so much I have recommended it to friends. I have dry and sensitive skin and this has been a life saver!

I've struggled with acne for probably 6 years. I've gone to the dermatologist for my skin and have been prescribed retinoids and other topical creams and medication. They helped clear my skin for a bit but it never prevented my acne and I would continue to get a lot of severe breakouts. That was until I tried this serum and I absolutely SWEAR by it. This product has gotten rid of a lot of my redness from scarring, and calms down my breakouts almost immediately. I've also noticed that I've had smoother skin. It also works really well with other topical creams if you use them. I've never had any sort of bad reaction. I can't imagine not having this serum in my routine!
